pokedexEntries.rb: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. Its vines shake as it walks.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick, blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.

pokedexEntries.go: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.

pokedexEntries.si: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

pokedexEntries.cr: During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.

pokedexEntries.rs: TANGELA’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.

pokedexEntries.fr: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

pokedexEntries.lg: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. The vines sway as it walks.

pokedexEntries.em: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

pokedexEntries.dp: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

pokedexEntries.pt: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

pokedexEntries.hg: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.

pokedexEntries.ss: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

pokedexEntries.bw: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

pokedexEntries.x: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

pokedexEntries.y: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

pokedexEntries.oras: Tangela’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.

pokedexEntries.sw: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

pokedexEntries.sh: The vines of a Tangela have a distinct scent. In some parts of Galar, Tangela vines are used as herbs.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

pokedexEntries.la: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they’re useful as a spice.
